findings.how_to_check: Run git status --short to observe ?? MATCHING/_run__tgt_only_run.do, and inspect line 1 to confirm the hardcoded path. Attempting to execute stata -b do MATCHING/_run__tgt_only_run.do from any directory other than D:\repos\fixing_transcription_errors will fail on the do command.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not commit MATCHING/_run__tgt_only_run.do; remove it from the working tree. In addition, add _run_*.do to .gitignore so temporary runner wrappers generated by replication/Run-Stata.ps1 do not pollute the working tree.
findings.title: Untracked Stata launcher hardcodes author-specific local repository path
findings.what_the_code_does: The launcher executes `capture noisily do "D:\repos\fixing_transcription_errors\MATCHING\_tgt_only_run.do"`, hardcoding the local machine's checkout directory instead of invoking the script relatively or through $REP_REPO.
findings.why_it_matters: As an untracked file marked ?? in the working tree, committing it breaks replication immediately on any machine where the repository is cloned to a different path or drive. It appears to be an uncleaned wrapper artifact left behind by an execution of replication/Run-Stata.ps1.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied; claims-vs-code review was evaluated against script comments, markdown headers, and review/briefs/2026-11-17-profile-jw-sd.md rather than manuscript text.
External census and profile datasets reside outside the repository and were not queried, precluding independent numerical verification of the calculated standard deviations.
The Stata pipeline was not executed; verification was performed by static analysis of code logic and Stata semantics.
Review was scoped to the uncommitted working-tree changes and untracked files rather than a full-repository audit.
Identification properties of FamilySearch profile linkage (such as selection into profiles with recorded death months) cannot be assessed without access to the underlying population datasets.
summary: The new spread-statistics block at the end of MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do is sound and faithfully mirrors the slide's sample and measure choices, asserting matched counts and paired differences across records. The only concrete defect is the untracked launcher MATCHING/_run__tgt_only_run.do, which hardcodes a local D: drive path; it should be deleted from the working tree and prevented from recurring by ignoring wrapper files in .gitignore.

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:250-258 selects full-name similarity (jn) for men and first-name similarity (jf) for women under `smp & has_dmonth & hasml & `gc'' (with gc partitioning all into cell==0 and inrange(cell,1,4)), exactly matching lines 199-216 and reproducing the slide's sample definitions.
verified_clean.item: Sample selection and metrics match existing slide definitions exactly

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:252 generates `_d = `m'_ml - `m'_anc` record by record, ensuring that diff mean and diff SD reflect the distribution of paired differences rather than independent marginal distributions.
verified_clean.item: Paired difference is constructed at the record level before computing spread statistics

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:262-267 executes `assert r(N)==`n'' after summarizing m_ml and _d, guaranteeing that nonmissing record counts are identical across Ancestry, model, and difference calculations.
verified_clean.item: Assertions prevent silent Stata sample attrition or missing value corruption

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:246 documents `diff/SD = mean diff divided by the SD of Ancestry's JW`, and line 270 implements `string(`dm'/`as', "%6.2f")`, scaling the mean paired difference by Ancestry's standard deviation as specified in review/briefs/2026-11-17-profile-jw-sd.md.
verified_clean.item: Standardized effect size diff/SD is calculated and documented consistently

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:245-246 titles the output 'Spread of Jaro-Winkler similarity to FamilySearch profile names' and describes the groups as agreement and disagreement, avoiding conflation of FamilySearch comparisons with truth.
verified_clean.item: Language accurately describes agreement rather than ground-truth accuracy

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:249 creates `_d` and line 275 drops `_d` before closing the file handle, leaving no lingering variables in memory.
verified_clean.item: Temporary difference variable is cleaned up after loop completion

verified_clean.evidence: The diff in MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do is strictly restricted to summary aggregation (summarize, assert, formatting, and writing to markdown) and introduces no regressions, clustering changes, or new causal claims.
verified_clean.item: No econometric regressions, weighting, or sample linkages are modified
